extracts.text: The Baltimore Ravens have lost a key rookie to injury, forcing another change up front against the Cincinnati Bengals. That alignment did not last. Rookie guard Vega Ioane left the game in the first quarter after getting up slowly following a third-down catch by Zay Flowers. He had just moved back to his natural position at right guard with Jurgens back in the lineup. Ioane was initially listed as questionable to return before the team made the final call. Emery Jones Jr. replaced him at right guard, the same role Jones filled earlier this season when Ioane had to shift inside.

MANCHESTER, England (AP) — The Ballon d'Or winners will be announced on Monday with a new generation of soccer stars, led by Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé, ready to stamp their name on the trophy that for so long was a personal duel between Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. Messi, of course, is still in the running for soccer's top individual prize at the age of 39 after his outstanding performances at the World Cup. The women's award, won by Barcelona and Spain star Aitana Bonmati for the past three years, will go to someone else this time around. Bonmati is not on the shortlist after breaking her leg in December.

LeBron James had Mercedes build two nearly identical Maybachs to his own design, and he's auctioning the second one for charity next month. The 2027 Mercedes-Maybach S 680 will be sold by Gooding Christie's at its first Retromobile New York auction on Nov. 20–21, WJW reported. The money goes to the LeBron James Family Foundation and its I Promise program in his hometown of Akron, Ohio. James worked with Mercedes on the design, and the auction car is a near-twin of the one he kept for himself. It has a light ivory exterior, his personal logo on details throughout, and a custom badge in place of the usual V12 emblem.

Amid an already strong start to his season, Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud has more weapons to work with in Houston’s offense. Marvin Harrison Jr. made his Texans debut in Week 6 after being traded from the Arizona Cardinals. South Carolina football was fined $500,000 on Oct. 25 after fans stormed the field to celebrate a 27-24 win against No. 11 Tennessee 27-24 on Oct. 24 at Williams-Brice Stadium. The fine will be paid to Tennessee in accordance with conference policy, which provides for a $500,000 penalty for violations involving access to competition areas in all SEC-sponsored sports. But SEC Commissioner Greg Sankey announced in 2025 that all offenses would draw the same fine of $500,000.

The Brewers fouled off 44 pitches last night; 22 of those were in two-strike counts With any team that's making a run to a championship, many different factors go into a team's success; for the Brewers, it's so difficult to narrow it down to just one. Of course, you've got the bullpen, the relentlessness of the offense, and a manager's trust in the midst of adversity. Security and democracy emerge as central issues in Israel's highly anticipated general election, as Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports. Why Israel's election is one of the most important in its history Close Israeli voters are preparing to head to the polls in an election some have described as the most consequential in the country's history. It's the first general election since the Hamas-led attacks of 7 October 2023. Tuesday's vote could see Benjamin Netanyahu's almost two-decade-long period of right-wing rule replaced by a more left-leaning government.

After three years of regional war, this is a battle Israel always knew was coming, writes Lucy Williamson. The general election on Tuesday hangs over a country that's deeply divided and ready for a fight. Every autumn, Corvo Island in the Azores turns off its public lighting for a few key days to help fledgling Cory’s shearwaters as they attempt to fly to the ocean guided by the stars O nce a year, Corvo, the smallest and most northerly island of Portugal’s Azores archipelago, goes dark. Since 2019, the island’s 450 or so inhabitants have chosen to switch off the lights every autumn for five nights to tackle the disastrous effects of artificial light on Cory’s shearwaters, a seabird endemic to the Atlantic Ocean. It began in 1991 when the community noticed huge numbers of deaths among young shearwaters.

The blitz-happy Vikings defense took their habit to the highest level on Sunday against the Colts. Via NBC Sports research, Minnesota blitzed on 85.2 percent of the Colts' dropbacks on Sunday. It was the highest rate by any team in the Next Gen Stats era, which dates back to 2016. The effort limited the Colts to 64 net passing yards, thanks to four sacks that erased 44 yards. The challenge comes from the confusion created by the Brian Flores defense. The offense never knows who is and isn't coming until the snap. It forces the blockers to quickly diagnose the situation, and it requires the quarterback to process his reads before he gets knocked down.

October's full Moon, nicknamed the Hunter's Moon, lit up the night sky this weekend. Full Moons throughout the year have traditionally been given names that reflect what is going on in nature . The firebrand left-winger, whose has at times been at odds with Trump, has won his fourth term as Brazil's president. On the face of it, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has done the impossible one more time - within three weeks he overturned defeat in first-round voting to gain re-election as Brazil's president. It was no mean achievement for a man who before his first successful run at the post in 2002 had tried three times unsuccessfully. When he became president in 2003, he came to office as the first leftist leader of Brazil in nearly half a century.

This is how his signature policy has played out after returning to power promising a closed border and mass deportations. When he famously stepped onto the golden escalator at Trump Tower to announce his candidacy for his first presidential term in 2015, he accused Mexico for of sending drugs and crime north of the border - and it's been a constant rallying cry ever since. Some of his first-term ambitions to stem the flow of would-be immigrants were constrained by the courts. But restraints have been weaker in his second term, with a more accommodating Supreme Court and tens of billions of additional enforcement money from Congress.

Company says foreign-made robotic vehicles are crucial to US chip production. The uncertainty surrounding the Federal Communications Commission ban on certain foreign-made robots was revealed in the agency’s decision to grant Intel’s waiver request. On October 22, the FCC published its order allowing Intel to continue using the foreign-made robots in US semiconductor manufacturing facilities for a period of one year. The robots in question are automated guided vehicles operating on “tracks or predefined paths” while often requiring operator oversight, according to Intel’s website. They help to move materials and items around within warehouses and factory floors.

The term "maxxing" is used as an adjective, adverb, noun and verb by many in Gen Z and Gen Alpha to describe an emphasis in optimisation. Americans have gone all in on "maxxing", making it the 2026 Word of the Year for Dictionary.com. Short for maximising, the term "can be used on its own or added to the end of any word to convey you're doing something to the fullest or optimizing it as much as possible", Dictionary.com said in a statement. It's a major departure from two years ago, when the site, after analysing US social media trends, news stories, and search data, chose "demure" as word of the year. Last year's was "67".

Case study gives a whole new meaning to "bedroom eyes." The man in this case was a 71-year-old crop farmer. He told doctors that for the previous two months he had the sensation of having something stuck in both his eyes, which were also red and blurry. When ophthalmologists took a look, they quickly saw the problem: multiple mobile, whitish roundworms. His eyes were not in good shape either, as one might expect. The blood vessels in the membrane over the eye, the conjunctiva, were enlarged, making his eyes look red. And the cells of his cornea—the transparent, dome-shaped outer layer of the eye—had eroded, potentially after the helminths’ hanky-panky.
